reason: B is the better-targeted, lower-fraction intervention: grain-boundary segregation by trace boron is a physically plausible route to suppress intergranular cracking while being less likely than several vol% SiC plus compositional Si/C changes to disrupt the transformation underlying caloric performance. Both proposals lack explicit numerical operating boundaries, and B needs direct evidence of boron’s boundary state, but its controlled toughness/fatigue and caloric comparison provides a clearer decisive test.
